description: A four-panel composite of bright-field TEM data for as-cast Fe–30Mn–10Al–1.5C–1.5Be low-density steel. (a), (b) and (c) are bright-field TEM micrographs, each with a 1 µm scale bar in the lower-left corner; (d) is a selected-area electron diffraction (SAED) spot pattern. (a) shows a cluster of coarse, dark, elongated needle- and plate-shaped precipitates, some intersecting at steep angles, in a lighter matrix. (b) shows a different precipitate morphology in the same steel: blocky, lath-like particles with irregular faceted boundaries, again on the micrometre scale. (c) shows a heavily striated, layered grain with a blue "SADP" annotation and a blue circle marking where the selected-area aperture was placed. (d) is the resulting SAED pattern, annotated in red "AlFe3", with reflections labelled 111, 1̄11 and 200 and the zone axis marked [011]. Together the panels catalogue the morphologies of the Be-bearing precipitates and use the indexed [011] AlFe3 pattern to establish that phase in the 1.5Be as-cast matrix. The caption attributes (a, b) to Be12Fe and (c, d) to AlFe3; the images themselves carry no phase labels other than that on (d).
measured_quantities: precipitate length (µm, via 1 µm scale bars)

observations.observation: Panels (a), (b) and (c) are bright-field TEM micrographs, each with a 1 µm scale bar printed in the lower-left corner.
Panel (a) shows coarse dark needle- and plate-shaped precipitates, several micrometres long, intersecting one another at high angle within a lighter matrix.
Panel (b) shows a different precipitate morphology from (a): blocky, lath-like particles with irregular faceted boundaries.
Panel (c) is annotated in blue with the text 'SADP' and a blue circle marking the selected-area diffraction aperture position on a striated grain.
Panel (d) is an SAED spot pattern with red labels: the phase 'AlFe3', reflections 111, 1̄11 and 200, and the zone axis [011].
The figure is of as-cast Fe–30Mn–10Al–1.5C–1.5Be low-density steel, imaged in bright-field TEM.
The caption assigns panels (a, b) to different morphologies of Be12Fe and panels (c, d) to morphology and diffraction spots of AlFe3.
The citing text states that the Be12Fe in this figure is large and mostly polymerised into a large needle-peak structure.
The citing text states that selective diffraction was performed on the 1.5Be matrix and the diffraction spot of AlFe3 was observed there.
The citing text states that in the 1.5Be steel large Be–Fe precipitates intersect horizontally and vertically, matching the crossing needles seen in (a).
No numeric size values are printed on any panel; precipitate sizes are only conveyed by the 1 µm scale bars.
The images themselves carry no phase labels except 'AlFe3' in (d); the Be12Fe assignment of (a) and (b) comes only from the caption.
